dialects.mssql-current: SELECT TOP (5) h.OrderNo, CAST(h.OrderDate AS date) AS OrderDay, h.Amount, h.CustomerName, 'DROP TABLE dbo.OrderHeader' AS SafetyText FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h WHERE h.TenantId = 1 AND h.Status = 'PAID' AND h.OrderDate >= CONVERT(datetime2(0), '2025-01-02T00:00:00') ORDER BY h.OrderDate ASC, h.OrderId ASC;
dialects.mssql-legacy: SELECT h.OrderNo, CONVERT(date, h.OrderDate) AS OrderDay, h.Amount, h.CustomerName, 'DROP TABLE dbo.OrderHeader' AS SafetyText FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h WHERE h.TenantId = 1 AND h.Status = 'PAID' AND h.OrderDate >= CONVERT(datetime2(0), '2025-01-02T00:00:00') ORDER BY h.OrderDate ASC, h.OrderId ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY OPTION (MAXDOP 1, FORCESEEK); -- UPDATE dbo.OrderHeader SET Amount = 0

dialects.mssql-current: SELECT h.OrderNo, h.CustomerName FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h WHERE h.TenantId = 2 AND h.Status = 'NEW' ORDER BY CASE WHEN h.CustomerName IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, h.CustomerName ASC, h.OrderId ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 6 ROWS ONLY;
dialects.mssql-legacy: SELECT h.OrderNo, h.CustomerName FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h WHERE h.TenantId = 2 AND h.Status = 'NEW' ORDER BY h.CustomerName ASC, h.OrderId ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 6 ROWS ONLY OPTION (MAXDOP 1);

dialects.mssql-current: SELECT h.OrderNo, DATETRUNC(day, h.OrderDate) AS DayValue, DATETRUNC(second, h.OrderDate) AS SecondValue FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h WHERE h.TenantId = 3 AND h.Status = 'SHIPPED' AND h.OrderDate >= CONVERT(datetime2(0), '2025-03-01T00:00:00') ORDER BY h.OrderDate ASC, h.OrderId ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 6 ROWS ONLY;
dialects.mssql-legacy: SELECT h.OrderNo, DATEADD(day, DATEDIFF(day, 0, h.OrderDate), 0) AS DayValue, DATEADD(second, DATEDIFF(second, 0, h.OrderDate), 0) AS SecondValue FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h WHERE h.TenantId = 3 AND h.Status = 'SHIPPED' AND h.OrderDate >= CONVERT(datetime2(0), '2025-03-01T00:00:00') ORDER BY h.OrderDate ASC, h.OrderId ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 6 ROWS ONLY OPTION (MAXDOP 1);

dialects.mssql-current: SELECT l.OrderId, l.LineNum, l.Sku, l.Quantity FROM dbo.OrderLine AS l WHERE l.TenantId = 3 AND l.Status = 'SHIPPED' AND TRY_CONVERT(bigint, l.Sku) = 1001 ORDER BY l.OrderId ASC, l.LineNum ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY;
dialects.mssql-legacy: SELECT l.OrderId, l.LineNum, l.Sku, l.Quantity FROM dbo.OrderLine AS l WHERE l.TenantId = 3 AND l.Status = 'SHIPPED' AND l.Sku = 1001 ORDER BY l.OrderId ASC, l.LineNum ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY OPTION (MAXDOP 1);

dialects.mssql-current: SELECT h.OrderNo, l.LineNum, l.Sku, l.Quantity, l.LineAmount FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h JOIN dbo.OrderLine AS l ON l.TenantId = h.TenantId AND l.OrderId = h.OrderId WHERE h.TenantId = 2 AND h.Status = 'PAID' AND l.TenantId = 2 AND l.Status = 'PAID' AND l.LineNum <= 2 ORDER BY h.OrderNo ASC, l.LineNum ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 8 ROWS ONLY;
dialects.mssql-legacy: SELECT h.OrderNo, x.LineNum, x.Sku, x.Quantity, x.LineAmount FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP (2) l.LineNum, l.Sku, l.Quantity, l.LineAmount FROM dbo.OrderLine AS l WHERE l.TenantId = 2 AND l.Status = 'PAID' AND l.OrderId = h.OrderId ORDER BY l.LineNum ASC) AS x WHERE h.TenantId = 2 AND h.Status = 'PAID' ORDER BY h.OrderNo ASC, x.LineNum ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 8 ROWS ONLY OPTION (MAXDOP 1);

dialects.mssql-current: SELECT h.OrderNo, h.ShipAddress FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h WHERE h.TenantId = 4 AND h.Status = 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY h.OrderNo ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY;
dialects.mssql-legacy: SELECT TOP (3) h.OrderNo, h.ShipAddress FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h WHERE h.TenantId = 4 AND h.Status = 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY h.OrderNo ASC OPTION (MAXDOP 1);

dialects.mssql-current: SELECT h.OrderNo, h.ShipAddress, h.UpdatedAt FROM dbo.OrderHeader AS h WHERE h.TenantId = 4 AND h.Status = 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY h.UpdatedAt DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 4 ROWS ONLY;
